items.title: Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks
items.summary: Accenture says hackers exploited MiCollab flaws before Mitel’s advisory, likely aided by AI, in a suspected extortion campaign. The post Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’
items.summary: FIFA didn’t say when the cyberattack took place, or the precise nature of the hacked information. The post FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’ appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-103406, the vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root. The post Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code
items.summary: A hacker used a compromised employee GitHub account to push malicious code and steal customer records, but vaults were not accessed. The post 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
items.summary: An ongoing phishing campaign dubbed "GoodGuys" impersonates major brands, including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX, to steal corporate Google and Okta credentials using fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars. [...]

items.title: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
items.summary: The Remus infostealer is stealing Gmail messages through a stealthy malicious Chrome extension, a capability the malware operators marketed as a zero-day exploit in Google's email service. [...]

items.title: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook
items.summary: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer malware delivered through Meta ads is enrolling browsers into enterprise-style management to force the installation of an extension that steals sensitive data, including Gmail and Outlook emails. [...]

items.title: Se l’intelligenza artificiale scrive le nostre cartelle cliniche
items.summary: Gli scriba basati su AI promettono di liberare i medici dalle carte, ma possono omettere informazioni importanti, alterare il contenuto delle visite e introdurre errori nelle cartelle cliniche. Spesso è il paziente ad accorgersene per primo.

items.title: Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting
items.summary: Drupal warns that its previous installer patch left some websites vulnerable to takeover, with attackers already exploiting the gap. The post Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites
items.summary: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday. [...]

items.title: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
items.summary: 1Password has disclosed a data breach after a an employee's corporate GitHub account was hacked and used to deploy malicious code to the company's backend services to steal customer data. [...]

items.title: CISA warns of critical unpatched flaw in Danfoss refrigeration controllers
items.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning about a critical vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controllers used by food retailers to manage commercial refrigeration, HVAC, and lighting systems. [...]

items.title: InfraTrust warns of exploited supply chain flaws in network appliances
items.summary: Eclypsium's November InfraTrust report warns that most infrastructure security advisories addressing exploited vulnerabilities over the past month involve flaws in third-party software bundled into products rather than code developed by the vendors themselves. [...]

items.title: ShinyHunters Claims Comeback, New Inception Group Rejects Alleged Ties

items.title: Microsoft confirms authentication issues after November updates
items.summary: Microsoft has confirmed that customers may experience authentication issues after installing November security updates that address a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability. [...]

items.title: Palo Alto Networks warns of Fragnesia flaw exploited in PAN-OS attacks
items.summary: Threat actors are chaining exploits for the PHP2Shell and Fragnesia vulnerabilities to target Palo Alto Networks devices with management interfaces exposed to the internet. [...]

items.title: Italy and Switzerland warn of autonomous AI-driven cyberattacks
items.summary: Swiss and Italian cybersecurity agencies are warning about automated cyberattacks powered by AI agents targeting organizations in the critical infrastructure sector. [...]

items.title: Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
items.summary: Attackers are probing GeoServer instances for two high-severity flaws that can be chained with other bugs for unauthenticated RCE. The post Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: More Pentests Without More Pentesters: Where AI Safely Helps
items.summary: Penetration testers spend a significant portion of their engagements on documentation, reporting, and other tasks outside of testing. PentestPad explains how AI can reduce this workload, help teams handle more engagements, and keep sensitive client data within their own infrastructure. [...]

items.summary: Rackspace is shutting down its Rackspace Spot cloud platform after a security breach allowed hackers to access customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets, giving customers until December 8 to migrate their services and download their data. [...]
